releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.30 polishes the Notes and Inbox changes from the previous release. English spelling suggestions are now ranked by local edit distance and similarity, so close corrections such as Holeday to Holiday are prioritized while spelling remains fully on-device and Arabic/numbers stay untouched. Inbox cards are more compact, long file names can use two lines, type and file size are shown together, and the detected source plus original folder are easier to read before choosing Category or Delete. Delete still removes only the private Smart Life Inbox copy. Existing Notes Color/Sort/List-Grid controls, Pin, Important, Sketch, Price Photos, backup, previews and file features are preserved.
